title: Chapter 274
text:
"Three consecutive draws, my knees are hurting."

"Wife, come out and look at God. There are no ads. "

Han Xiao was shocked. He had only put three purple equipment in this batch, and he did not do anything behind the scenes. However, all of them were picked by one person. This luck was unbelievable. He almost wanted to skin Half A Cigarette When Lonely to see if it was Bennett hiding inside.

Half A Cigarette When Lonely was in a daze. At this moment, So Poor That Only Has Money walked over with admiration.

"Do you have some kind of trick? Teach me, I can pay." So Poor That Only Has Money's eyes were shining.

"What trick? I'm just lucky." Half A Cigarette When Lonely quickly waved his hands.

King of Single Draws blacked out.

In front of luck, all metaphysics was bullsh * t.

After selling the chests, Han Xiao left. Half A Cigarette When Lonely was immediately surrounded by players. Some believed that he had a special trick to open the chests, and some had bad intentions. However, the Main City was a safe zone, so they did not dare to act rashly.

"Friend, are you selling purple equipment? The price is negotiable."

"Not selling." Half A Cigarette When Lonely subconsciously answered. He turned around and saw that it was a male player who spoke. When he saw the other party's ID, he suddenly took a deep breath.

Guild leader, Morning Snow Twilight Frost!

The four biggest esports clubs in China were Temple of God, Long Sky, Dynasty, and Fried Eggplants with Fish. Ancient Dynasty was the official guild of Dynasty. Temple of God's Li Ge was ranked second in the official Chinese player rankings, and the first was Dynasty's signature. Ancient Dynasty followed the club's low-key style, and they were considered an exception among the top clubs. However, no one dared to look down on them.

"I see." Morning Snow Twilight Frost scratched his chin and casually said, "Do you want to join our guild?"

Half A Cigarette When Lonely was pleasantly surprised and quickly agreed. Morning Snow Twilight Frost directly sent the guild invitation over. After Half A Cigarette When Lonely agreed, a new guild title appeared on his interface. Half A Cigarette When Lonely felt that joining a top club so easily was unreal.

He said that he hated guilds because he had applied to join some guilds but was always rejected. However, those small guilds were nothing compared to the Qianyu Dynasty. Now that the guild leader of a major guild had personally invited him, Half a Cigarette in the Loneliness felt his depression dissipate. His whole body was relaxed and he felt as if he was floating on air.

"The guilds monopolize the resources, but this kind of lucky draw is a chance for normal players like us to make a comeback. This is the only way we can get high-level equipment with very little capital. Black Phantom's mechanical box is a blessing." Half A Cigarette When Lonely was secretly happy.

The popularity continued to rise, and the Blue Star forums were discussing this enthusiastically. Players posted all kinds of posts, and some of them gave examples to calculate the drop rate of the chests. Below that, there were players who used the King of Single Draw as a negative example, lashing out at the King of Single Draw's scarred heart. Even So Poor That All That Was Left With Money did not escape this kind of treatment. His story of getting a hundred blue equipment in a row was shared by the players gloatingly.

Half A Cigarette When Lonely's godly luck was mentioned. After a few more chests, Half A Cigarette When Lonely's luck was still as good as before. He got two more purple equipment, which attracted a lot of envy. With so many purple equipment in his hands, his combat power would definitely not be weak. Everyone also realized that he had joined the Qianyu Dynasty guild, and they could only be envious. The other guilds all regretted that they did not make the first move.

Han Xiao was tempted and wanted to pull Half A Cigarette When Lonely into the team, but he gave up after thinking about it. Luck was something that could be good and bad at times was not reliable. Half A Cigarette When Lonely's standard did not meet the recruitment criteria that he had set. Compared to illusory luck, Han Technician preferred real ability.

Other than the posts on the forums, there were also people calculating all the items that had been dropped from the chests so far, such as mechanical equipment, useful materials, and parts. As a scientific introduction post, the large number of good items attracted even more players. Players from all continents were very envious of the chests opening event in Sanctuary Three.

More players from the Southern Continent came over because of the reputation. The players who were recruited by the expedition team could not wait to return. They thought that there would be many missions and opportunities in the war, but the situation changed completely. After Han Xiao stole the Germinal Organization's secrets, the Germinal Organization did not even put up a decent fight, so the players could not even do anything.

The players from the Western Continent and Northern Continent hated that they were not born in the Southern Continent. They wished that they could grow wings and fly to Sanctuary Three. Because of the war, cross-continental flights were temporarily closed, so they could only look but not touch. The players from Andrea were the unluckiest group of people. It felt like nothing good had happened to them ever since they had created their character.

The chests opening event was a huge success, so Han Xiao started a new event to strengthen his position. This time, the method was to release a type of prize-pool mission on a regular basis as another regular event in the main city. The response was not bad, and the players saw more benefits. At the same time, it increased the variety of activities in the main city.

Han Xiao took out some material and guided Pork Bun to make a new episode, introducing the experience and deeds of 'Han Xiao' in more detail than the posts on the forums. This deepened his impression in the hearts of the players again, so the players had a deeper understanding of his' deeds'. It also indirectly promoted Sanctuary Three.

Han Xiao valued the response of the players, so he paid attention to the forums in his free time. In the eyes of Hella and the others, he seemed to be in a daze.

"A new episode has been released, and the subtitle is actually 'The War of the Blue Star'? The Galaxy Times rarely uses a single planet as the theme, but this time, it's focusing on the Blue Star. I don't remember there being such an episode in my previous life. "

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled, and he clicked on the video.

"Hello, players," the male host said, "this is the Galaxy Times, dedicated to sharing first-hand game information and protecting your gaming career."

"Little Chun, I've been learning to play an instrument recently," the female host said.

"Really? What instrument are you learning, Qiuqiu?"

"Let me show you. Guess what I'm playing."

The female host took out her guitar and played for a while. The melody was very familiar, and it seemed to be a famous song. After she finished playing, the female host asked, "Little Chun, can you guess what I'm playing?"

"You're playing the guitar."

“”

The opening joke of every episode was as cold as always. Han Xiao felt like his bladder was about to freeze.

After this segment, they finally entered the main event. The two hosts first talked about the recent trends in the professional circle and the problems that the players had encountered, then changed the topic and cut to the main topic.

"Recently, the Blue Star events have been happening frequently. The Six Nations and the Germinal Organization have a world-wide conflict. Players have experienced it personally, and there is no doubt that this is a main storyline event of a planet. Compared to other planets, the Blue Star main storyline broke out first, which is very typical. Therefore, in this episode, we will analyze the Blue Star main storyline war, summarize the characteristics of the main storyline event, and speculate about its future impact."

Hearing this, Han Xiao finally understood why this episode appeared. Under his operation, the main storyline war between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization broke out more than a year earlier, and now was only the early stage of the players. The main storyline of most of the novice planets was still in preparation. Blue Star, where a global war broke out, naturally became the most eye-catching planet, which was very good material for the show.

The two hosts first introduced the background of the Blue Star planet, then began to analyze.

"The war has lasted for nearly two months, and it has entered the final stage. Now, the Germinal Organization is on the verge of defeat. The impact of the war on the planet's environment is also very obvious. The power structure has changed, and a large faction of players is facing the crisis of destruction. The players of the Germinal Organization are in a worse situation. There are a few possibilities as to what they will do after the war. Maybe they will become the remnants of the Germinal Organization, join the Six Nations, or leave the faction and become wanderers.

"From this incident, we can see the characteristics of the main storyline. It has major changes, a large scale, far-reaching impact, and so on.

"However, although the Blue Star players participated in the war main storyline, their role was not obvious. They played the role of ordinary soldiers, and their impact on the events was limited. Of course, we also saw more possibilities. The average level of the players is low now, but it should be different when their level is higher. Therefore, players from other planets can look forward to their own main storyline events.

"Because the participation of the players was not high, we suspect that the Blue Star main storyline was too rushed. From the perspective of the players, it was more like an interlude. Based on this idea, our program team summarized the information dug up by the players on the forum and found an interesting phenomenon. Please take a look, these are the two possibilities that we have concluded for the development of the Blue Star main storyline."

At this time, two tables appeared in the video, with different content written on them. They wrote about the transformative events before the expedition war began.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. One of the tables had his deeds, such as escaping from the Germinal Organization, leaking information that caused the Germinal Organization's base to collapse, and so on. These were all in the current storyline. He had exposed his identity, and this information had been shared with the players through different channels. In the tables, his deeds were marked in red.

The other table removed his deeds, and the result of the deduction was completely different. It believed that the conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization would start from the bases on the various continents, and all the players would be able to participate in it. The players would be able to grow in it, and the war would only start after they reached higher levels. The war would last several times longer than the current one.

"Interesting, this is very similar to the storyline in my previous life. To be able to notice this, their logic and observation skills are very detailed. Indeed, there are many crouching tigers and hidden dragons among the players." Han Xiao's interest was piqued, and he continued watching.

"As you can see, the conclusions of the two tables are completely different," the male host said. "One is the current storyline, and the other is the predicted storyline. However, the predicted storyline seems to have more characteristics of the main storyline. So, what caused the difference in the results?"
